entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say or enter your order number.
Thank you. Connecting you to an agent now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Diana. I see you're calling about order 91-V-4-2-8. How can I help you today?
I need to return the shoes from that order. Just tell me yes or no, can I get a refund?
I can definitely look into that for you. I see the order is for our Mountain Peak cycling shoes. To confirm, is there a technical fault with them, or is it more of a preference issue?
They're giving me blisters. I don't care what you call it. I've tried adjusting the cleats, different socks, everything. They just don't work for my feet.
I'm very sorry to hear that; getting blisters is certainly a valid reason for a return. One moment while I check the delivery date... Okay, I see they were delivered 41 days ago.
So? Is that a yes or a no on the refund?

It's a yes. Your purchase is unfortunately outside our 10-day return policy. And I see you're a VIP member with us, so I've gone ahead and processed that return authorization for you immediately. The return label is on its way to your email now.
Okay, good. So I just print the label and send the shoes back?

That's correct. Once we receive them, the full refund will be issued to your original payment method. And for the trouble, I've also added a credit for free 2-day shipping to your account for your next order.
You're very welcome. Thank you for being a VeloFit VIP. Have a great day.
